expectations.text: Promotes CalVer for this project and names both conditions: single-digit compatibility is impossible for a multi-surface project, and a time-based deprecation rule already runs
expectations.evidence: "Single-digit compatibility is impossible when every release removes something... and you already run a time-based deprecation rule."

expectations.text: States that CalVer moves the compatibility contract into prose and writes that compatibility rule explicitly, saying what a release may remove and under what notice
expectations.evidence: "CalVer moves the contract into prose"; Deprecation section with removal notice.

expectations.text: Specifies unpadded, PEP 440 normalized spelling such as 26.1.0 and rejects padded months
expectations.evidence: "Segments are never zero-padded"; "normalized PEP 440 form, for example `27.2.0`"

expectations.text: States that 26.x sorts above 7.14 so the switch preserves ordering and needs no epoch
expectations.evidence: "`7.14.x` sorts below `27.1.0` under PEP 440, so no epoch is needed."

expectations.text: Writes the deprecation window as removal no earlier than two releases and one year after the deprecation, noting that two releases at three per year is under a year so the time part binds
expectations.evidence: "two feature releases and 12 months... whichever is later"; "two releases is about 8 months"

expectations.text: Requires the replacement to be named in each deprecation warning and linked from the changelog
expectations.evidence: "Warning text: the replacement..."; "recorded in the changelog"

expectations.text: Recommends a stable identifier per deprecation because the project deprecates often
expectations.evidence: "`QF-DEP-0042` that the warning also prints"

expectations.text: Names the misreading risk that users read year-based numbers as SemVer majors, and writes that misreading into the policy
expectations.evidence: "read the year as a major"; "It is the same calendar year, not a compatibility guarantee."

expectations.text: States what ~=26.0 buys a pip user under the written policy, same calendar year
expectations.evidence: "`quillforge~=27.1` means `>=27.1, ==27.*`... same calendar year, not a compatibility guarantee."

expectations.text: States that Dependabot reads a year rollover as a major and a month as a minor, so dependents' type-based automerge rules are wrong by default
expectations.evidence: "The year rollover reads as a major. A change in `N` reads as a minor." plus the automerge hazard.

expectations.text: Recommends that the project publish what each segment means so dependents can write a per-package rule, such as Renovate regex versioning
expectations.evidence: Asks dependents to automerge only MICRO and gives a Renovate packageRules sketch.

expectations.text: Keeps a time-based cadence and states that no empty release ships to keep the calendar
expectations.evidence: "We never publish an empty release to fill a slot."

expectations.text: Announces the scheme change at least one release ahead and names the last 7.x version with its support end date
expectations.evidence: "Announce... in the `7.15` release notes"; "State the last `7.x` version and its support end date."
